# The consumers a release of ns3-tools is checked against before it ships
# (swarm-routing/.github#482): release.yml passes this file as
# reusable-release.yml's `downstream-consumers`, and a dry run builds and
# tests each line on ns3-dev latest-debug with this repository's checkout as
# the `sim-tools` line (swarm-routing/.github tools/downstream/downstream.sh,
# whose header documents the columns; the line's name must be the repository
# name, which the release passes as DOWNSTREAM_LOCAL). Report-only.
#
#   name | owner/repo@ref | ns-3 | modules | suites | stage | run
#
# sim-tools alone: routing-bench's suite through test.py, then through the
# bare test runner three times, as a consumer invokes it (#211).
sim-tools | swarm-routing/sim-tools@main | 3.42+ | routing-bench=sim-tools/ns3/routing-bench | routing-bench | | cd /opt/ns-3 && r=$(find build/utils -name 'ns3.*-test-runner-*' -type f -print -quit) && for i in 1 2 3; do "$r" --suite=routing-bench; done
# AntHocNet, the main consumer: its install stages this checkout's
# routing-bench (NS3_TOOLS_DIR) in place of the release its ns3-tools.lock
# names, beside its own arm modules; its suites, routing-bench's suite through
# the bare runner beside `adaptive` (#211), and its example.
AntHocNet | swarm-routing/AntHocNet@main | 3.36+ | swarm-core=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/swarm-core routing-bench=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/routing-bench oracle=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/oracle aomdv=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/aomdv gpsr=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/gpsr adaptive=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/adaptive anthocnet=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/anthocnet | anthocnet oracle adaptive routing-bench | mkdir -p .stage/contrib && touch .stage/CMakeLists.txt && NS3_TOOLS_DIR=/w/sim-tools make -s install-ns3 NS3DIR="$PWD/.stage" | cd /opt/ns-3 && r=$(find build/utils -name 'ns3.*-test-runner-*' -type f -print -quit) && for i in 1 2 3; do "$r" --suite=routing-bench; done && ./ns3 run --no-build anthocnet-example
